details: Positive comments from President Donald Trump regarding US-Iran negotiations have led to a rally in cryptocurrency markets as geopolitical risks ease. Bitcoin briefly surged past $60,400, Ethereum saw a 2.8% gain, and the overall crypto market capitalization increased to $2.14 trillion, indicating investors are shifting away from traditional safe-haven assets.
title: US-Iran De-escalation Lifts Crypto Markets

details: Former President Donald Trump disclosed earnings of at least $1.4 billion in 2025 from businesses related to cryptocurrencies and memecoins. This significant income, detailed in his latest annual financial filing, underscores growing mainstream and political engagement with digital assets.
title: Trump Reports Over $1.4 Billion in 2025 Crypto Income

details: The Bank for International Settlements (BIS) has issued a warning that current stablecoins contain inherent structural flaws that could negatively affect macroeconomic and financial stability if their adoption becomes widespread. Concerns highlighted include inadequate protection against financial crime, issues with redeemability, and potential challenges to monetary sovereignty due to their common denomination in US dollars.
title: BIS Cites "Structural Flaws" in Stablecoins, Warns of Financial Risk

details: The US private sector added only 98,000 jobs in June, significantly below the forecasted 118,000 and marking the weakest monthly increase since March. This softer labor market data is viewed positively by crypto and risk asset markets, as it could temper the Federal Reserve's hawkish stance on interest rate hikes.
title: Weak US Job Data May Ease Fed Hawkishness, Bullish for Crypto

details: Bitcoin has fallen below the $59,000 level, pressured by broader macroeconomic concerns and sustained outflows from Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs). US-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded their largest monthly exodus in June, with approximately $4.5 billion withdrawn, bringing total net withdrawals for 2026 to around $5.5 billion.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $59K Amid Macro Concerns & ETF Outflows
